description: This file defines the class OrderTotal, representing an entity related to order totals in an e-commerce application. It contains fields such as title, code, order, module, and value, along with their respective getters and setters.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: Entity class representing total details for an order, including title, code, order sequence, module, and value.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the order total.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the order total.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code associated with the order total.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for the order total.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module name related to this total.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the monetary value of this total.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the monetary value of this total.
